autoHelp: Gives everyone who joins the Member role. Bagel never hands out VIP, Subscriber or Regulars from Twitch: those stay yours to give.
leadModHelp: Senior moderators. Counted as staff on tickets.
memberHelp: Given to everyone who joins while automatic roles are on.
modsHelp: Your moderators. Counted as staff on tickets.
ownerHelp: Full control. Bagel treats this role as staff everywhere.
pinHelp: A pinned slot keeps the role you chose: the next setup adopts it instead of creating or renaming one by name.
droppedPins: Pinned role for {slots} was not found, so Bagel created one instead. Pick another role below if that is not what you wanted.
regularsHelp: Bagel creates this role. You hand it out yourself.
help: Pick which Discord role each Bagel slot means. Pin one and setup adopts it instead of creating another.
title: Roles
subscriberHelp: Bagel creates this role and its private channels. You hand it out yourself.
vipHelp: Bagel creates this role and its private channels. You hand it out yourself.
